current_grouping: Subpart E — Power-Plant Installations; Reciprocating Engines

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart E — Power-Plant Installations; Reciprocating Engines
versions.text: Each liquid cooled engine shall be provided with an independent cooling system. The cooling system shall be so arranged that no air or vapor can be trapped in any portion of the system, except the expansion tank, either during filling or during operation.
